name: Shimon Blau

summary.text: Shimon Blau is a physician with more than 20 years of experience and a small business owner running as an unaffiliated candidate for Colorado's 1st Congressional District.
He grew up in Denver and returned to the city 13 years ago; he launched his campaign and petitioned onto the November ballot within days of Melat Kiros' Democratic primary win.

experience.text: Practicing physician for more than 20 years; small business owner.

positions.source_title: Shimon Blau - Ballotpedia (2026 Candidate Connection survey)
positions.quote: Healthcare is a right, not a luxury, and no one should have to choose between getting the care they need and paying their bills. While I believe we should ultimately work toward universal healthcare, there are practical steps we can take now to lower costs.

positions.source_title: Congressional District 1: Kiros faces Peterson, Blau
positions.quote: Criminal aliens who threaten public safety should be deported, and our streets must be safer. At the same time, we should fast-track legal status for long-term, contributing members of our communities who have built their lives here.
positions.note: Explicitly mixed: supports deporting those who threaten public safety while opposing broader enforcement he calls indiscriminate.

positions.source_title: Colorado U.S. House District 1 candidate Q&A
positions.quote: I would advocate for protecting these lands, expanding responsible renewable energy, and ensuring federal agencies consider conservation, recreation, wildlife, and local communities in leasing decisions.
positions.note: Qualified support ('responsible' renewable energy) rather than an unqualified call to accelerate the shift.
